item.title: Northvale Grid Authority reports 4.8 GW of AI data center requests in its interconnection queue
item.description: Data center developers have asked the Northvale Grid Authority to connect 4.8 GW of new load, up from 1.9 GW a year earlier, according to its quarterly interconnection queue report. Only 0.9 GW has signed agreements, studies take 14 months, and the authority will add a readiness deposit for new requests.
